sources.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / faithful game-sprite reskin.
Asset type: THREE-frame Fire X2 attack sheet, ONE HORIZONTAL ROW of THREE equal square cells, transparent background.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and SOLE POSE/CHOREOGRAPHY authority: original X2 three-frame low-resolution sword-and-shield sequence. Image 2 is APPEARANCE ONLY: use its woman, clothing and rendered-volume material style; NEVER use its ready stance or forward-up blade pose.
Task: replace only the featureless original actor with our Laema avatar while preserving each original frame's visible joint positions, torso rotation, sword hand position, shield orientation and especially sword direction. Do not redesign the attack. The attack faces a target to SCREEN RIGHT but the SWORD SWEEPS BACKWARD TO SCREEN LEFT. THIS IS INTENTIONAL; DO NOT MIRROR IT or 'correct' it into a forward thrust.
Exact output layout: same three equal cells in one row, roughly1536x512. No labels, arrows, panel borders, floor, background, opponent or shadow. In each cell keep head near(240,210), hip near(235,310), broad planted stance matching the reference, full inferred boots ending around y470. The old source cuts the lower legs; complete those naturally, without changing visible hip/knee spread. Entire sword and body within cell.
Laema identity: adult woman, long silver-white ponytail tied red, cream rolled shirt sleeves, short blue vest, red waist sash, brown trousers/boots/gloves. One plain straight silver steel sword in RIGHT hand; one small round navy shield with silver rim and central steel boss on LEFT forearm. Same avatar proportions and equipment every frame. Ignore ornate gold hilt in appearance reference: use simple steel crossguard.
Three frames map directly, one-for-one, to image1:
FRAME1: exact compact original chamber. Torso toward right, right sword elbow bent across/in front of torso, sword hand at front-right abdomen. Sword blade points DIAGONALLY DOWN-LEFT across the hip, not up-right. Shield is close over front-right chest. Preserve the bent-arm silhouette.
FRAME2: original BACKWARD SWEEP. Right shoulder opens and RIGHT SWORD ARM EXTENDS toward SCREEN LEFT/REAR, approximately shoulder level. Sword continues from the fist diagonally DOWN-LEFT toward the rear-left, as image1. Shield stays in front to the RIGHT of chest, exposing the same broad navy face as original. Keep the small original WHITE crescent motion-streak cluster at the FORWARD RIGHT side as seen in this frame; do not turn it into fire, a projectile or magical shield.
FRAME3: exact original extended-left finish: right arm remains stretched toward SCREEN LEFT/REAR; straight blade points almost HORIZONTALLY LEFT, only slightly downward, NOT right. Shield still covers front-right chest. Same torso/leg stance as original. No white streak here.
Critical: match ORIGINAL silhouette and sword angles over conventional sword logic. No raised sword, overhead strike, forward sword extension, thrust, shield bash, extra recovery frame, hair redesign, reverse facing or new effect. THREE drawings only. Clean genuinely transparent alpha and crisp sprite shading matching appearance reference.
